name: NextChat Self-Hosted AI Chat
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted AI chat interface for OpenAI-compatible, local and cloud model endpoints; Docker/Node deployment with no NextChat software subscription or vendor-set chat quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted software is free, not the separately marketed hosted NextChat service. Cloud LLM API tokens, model inference, server/hosting and optional external services may cost money; secure access codes and API keys.
